title: PlayCase
summary: A gaming case that brings physical controls to the iPhone.
label: Independent product
paragraphs: I designed and built PlayCase from concept to production, managing every aspect of the product lifecycle—from industrial design and prototyping to marketing and community engagement. The case features swappable faceplates with button layouts tailored for popular emulators like Delta and RetroArch, enabling users to play classic console games with real buttons on their iPhone.

title: Sea Education Association
summary: Website design and development for ocean education.
label: Client project
paragraphs: Website design and development for Sea Education Association, an organization connecting students with ocean education and exploration. The original portfolio documents the work through desktop and mobile website imagery.

title: The School for Field Studies
summary: Website design and content systems for environmental field studies.
label: Client project
paragraphs: I designed and developed a new website for the School for Field Studies, restructuring content and systems architecture to make ongoing maintenance easier for the client. The project connects environmental field education with a clear, accessible digital experience.

title: USA Archery Live
summary: Live broadcasts, motion graphics, and scoring systems for national archery events.
label: National events
paragraphs: As Live Stream Producer for USA Archery, I filled all key production roles using minimal staff and resources for their national events. I build and support the streaming A/V tech stack, create motion graphics, integrate real-time scoring with USAA data, execute on-site production, and develop custom software to support the broadcast.

title: Steam Deck HQ
summary: Brand identity and web development for a handheld gaming publication.
label: Independent platform
paragraphs: Steam Deck HQ was created with the idea to find out the best ways to configure not only games, but everything related to the handheld gaming device, the Steam Deck. It is a resource for how to optimize your gaming experience and has built a community of passionate gamers.
The original portfolio reported more than one million monthly page views. This is a historical figure from the earlier site, not a current audience measurement.

title: National event identities
summary: A series of identities for USA Archery’s national events.
label: USA Archery
paragraphs: Over the last seven years, I’ve had the privilege of designing the logos for USA Archery’s national events. Each year, I strive to innovate and evolve the brand while staying true to its core design motifs, ensuring consistency and growth in its visual identity.

title: Team USA Olympic Jerseys
summary: Team USA archery jerseys for the Tokyo and Paris Olympic Games.
label: 2020 & 2024 Olympic Games
paragraphs: Designed of Team USA archery jerseys for the 2020 Tokyo and 2024 Paris Olympic Games. Responsible for concept development, visual direction, and production-ready artwork. Collaborated with athletes, USA Archery, and apparel manufacturers to create designs that balanced performance requirements with national identity and Olympic branding standards.

title: Workplace Solutions
summary: Website redesign, presentations, and video for a commercial interiors company.
label: Client project
paragraphs: Redesigned and launched a new website for Workplace Solutions, modernizing the company’s digital presence with a focus on clarity, professionalism, and user experience. In addition, contributed to the development of multiple pitch decks, elevating the delivery with engaging video content for prospective clients.

title: Archery is for Everyone
summary: An inclusive archery campaign with USA Archery and Marvel Entertainment.
label: USA Archery × Marvel
client: USA Archery, in collaboration with Marvel Entertainment
paragraphs: As the creative manager for USA Archery’s “Archery is for Everyone” campaign, I led efforts to showcase archery’s inclusivity through multiple touchpoints. I filmed and edited a 30-second video blending live-action and AI-generated cartoon sequences, featured as a preroll ad on marvel.com to engage Marvel fans. Additionally, I designed graphics, apparel, and marketing materials for club leaders and the usarchery.org store. I also coordinated the development of an “event finder” on usarchery.org, connecting users with participating clubs and events. This campaign was a collaboration between USA Archery and Marvel Entertainment.

title: U.S. Open Fan Experience
summary: A motion-tracking installation for the 2016 U.S. Open.
label: 2016 U.S. Open
paragraphs: Designed and developed an interactive installation for the 2016 US Open using Microsoft Kinect and C#. The experience engaged attendees through motion tracking and responsive visuals, blending real-time interactivity with principles of game design to create an immersive, intuitive experience. The project was built from the ground up, integrating hardware, software, and user-centered design.

title: SFS Recruitment Brochure
summary: Recruitment brochures for the School for Field Studies.
label: Client project
paragraphs: I designed the School for Field Studies recruitment brochures for 2023 and 2024, helping introduce its programs to students at colleges across the country. The work brings together photography, program information, and an editorial structure built for exploration.

title: Newton
summary: A desktop workspace for persistent AI teams.
label: Independent software · In development
paragraphs: Newton is a local desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. I’m building a place where projects, conversations, roles, and recurring work stay connected over time.

The app brings Codex CLI and Claude Code into one workspace, with separate project teams, saved conversations, scheduled routines, and handoffs between teammates. Illustrated characters give each role a recognizable presence.

The work spans interface design and the underlying system: a React and TypeScript front end, a Tauri desktop shell, and a Rust runtime that keeps track of work beyond the app window. Newton is an independent application in active development.

title: Current
summary: A live rhyme studio with speech input and phrase suggestions.
label: Independent software · In development
paragraphs: Current is a live rhyme studio for finding the next line while you rap. It connects spoken or typed words to rhyme suggestions, vowel matches, and phrase ideas in a single working surface.
I’m exploring how software can support a creative moment without interrupting it: keeping useful suggestions in view, grouping related sounds, and making the emerging rhyme scheme easy to follow.

The interface brings together your flow, phrase ideas, and a rhyme log. Session audio and transcript tools support revisiting the work. This is an independent project in active development; the screenshot documents its September 2026 interface.

title: Arcadia
summary: An exploration of AI coordination and interactive simulation.
label: Independent experiment
paragraphs: Arcadia explores the relationship between an AI workspace and a simulated world. It brings together an agent dashboard and a life simulation, asking how software activity can become something you can see and navigate as a place.

The work investigates agent coordination, persistent event history, character behavior, and spatial interaction. The agent system and simulation keep distinct responsibilities while contributing to the same experience.
This is an ongoing exploration in creative software and human–AI interaction. It sits alongside Newton and Current as part of my interest in building tools with a sense of presence and play.
